v5_evidence_summary.quote_blocker_pool1: Insufficient liquidity in binArrays (active bin too far from liquidity; bin_step=2 tight spacing)

decision.paid_rpc_required_reason: Single-account path bypasses V4 multi-account 403 blocker; quote is achievable for some pools (pool 2 with bin_step=100); pool 1 (bin_step=2 tight spacing) needs more bin array coverage; can be fixed either by (a) extending coverage to more bin arrays (5-7 instead of 3) using public RPC, OR (b) paid RPC GPA. NOT a hard blocker.
decision.single_account_path_covers: active bin + 2 neighbors = 210 bins; sufficient for tight liquidity pools (wide bin_step), may need extension for loose liquidity pools (tight bin_step)

alternative_to_paid_rpc.method: Extend bin array coverage without paid RPC
alternative_to_paid_rpc.approach: 1) Use binIdToBinArrayIndex(activeBinId) to get active index; 2) Loop offset from -3 to +3 (or wider) to get 7+ bin arrays; 3) For each, deriveBinArray to get pubkey; 4) Use single-account getAccountInfo on each (public RPC OK); 5) Pass all to swapQuote
alternative_to_paid_rpc.estimated_success_rate: high (90%+); only fails if pool has very wide price gap

if_paid_rpc_decision_yes.reason: Meteora DLMM connector wants to support ALL pools including tight bin_step pools with very wide liquidity distribution; needs to enumerate bin arrays up to the full price range
provider_capability_needed: supports high-volume account reads (no rate limit on Meteora bin arrays)
not rate-limited on multi-account getMultipleAccounts calls
if_paid_rpc_decision_yes.provider_options_NOT_recommended: do NOT output specific vendor recommendations (Helius / Triton / QuickNode); just describe capabilities

if_sdk_bug_decision.reason: single-account path worked; SDK is functional; no SDK bug observed

next_stage_recommendation: LP_METEORA_DLMM_KNOWN_POOL_CONNECTOR_FIX_REPEAT (if V5 wants to extend coverage for tight bin_step pools via wider bin array sweep, this is the next iteration of connector logic; no paid RPC needed in this round; paid RPC remains a Phase 2B concern)
operator_input_options: If V5 fix_repeat can extend bin array coverage to 5-7 arrays and reach higher quote success rate: stay on public RPC; no paid RPC needed
If V5 fix_repeat still hits limits (e.g. >210 bins needed, or single-account also blocked for some bin arrays): operator provides paid RPC
If V5 wants to skip extension and use paid RPC: operator provides paid RPC; 100% quote success
